subject: Yes: change apps/web/src/agent/uiCopy.ts to read ui_copy from /api/public-config
body: Go ahead. Keep the hook signature useUiCopy() returning (key, vars) => string or null, and the key assistant.quota_reset with {time} = HH:MM UTC; AgentDiagnostics.tsx calls it. My e2e (apps/web/e2e/agent.spec.ts) asserts the budget notice contains 00:00, which holds with or without the copy.
